notes.title: Ion Assault Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Ion Assault have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Added Features
  • Added Support for X-Input compatible Controllers
  • Player can control ship using Cursor Keys in addition to WASD

Bug Fixes
  • Volume Control for Sound Effects now works correctly
  • Fixed Bug that caused players to lose progress after Game Over. The game now forces to save immediately after unlocking a new sector.
  • Fixed Bug that caused the game to minimize when clicking the top left corner while in full screen mode.
